case_number: Crl. Appeal No. 634 of 2023 @ SLP (Crl.) No. 2454 of 2022; Crl. Appeal No. 635 of 2023 @ SLP (Crl.) No. 7306 of 2022
summary: CBI investigation sought into alleged police abduction of accused from Odisha hotel; NDPS charges framing challenged; illegal detention claim vs state's stance on lawful apprehension; standard for CBI referral: exceptional circumstances beyond mere allegations; high court's reliance on established guidelines upheld; case foisting allegation unsubstantiated by evidence.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court orders upheld; CBI investigation not directed; proceedings to continue before trial court.
